title: Predilection
summary: PREDILEC'TION, noun [Latin proe, before, and dilectus, dilito, to love.] A previous liking; a prepossession of mind in favor of something.

inlines.v: PREDILEC'TION, noun [Latin proe, before, and dilectus, dilito, to love.] A previous liking; a prepossession of mind in favor of something.
